t.7758-29-4.agn: It has no EU harmonised classification and is not in any hazard class in the registrants' joint notification. The real issue is the environment: phosphate contributes to excessive algal growth in lakes and seas, so the EU has limited the phosphorus content of consumer laundry and dishwasher detergents.
t.7758-29-4.reg.clp: No EU harmonised classification. Registrants' joint notification (37.3% of notifications): not classified.
t.7758-29-4.reg.p: Total phosphorus at most 0.5 g per standard dose in consumer laundry detergents (since 2013) and 0.3 g in consumer automatic dishwasher detergents (since 2017).
t.7758-29-4.summary: A water softener (builder) from the phosphate group.
t.7758-29-4.what: Binds calcium and magnesium in water so the detergent works better, and stops dirt from settling back.
